goal: press the button to stop the cube just as it reaches the target for the second time

menu.label: a
menu.action: move to the top of the button to prepare

menu.label: c
menu.action: press button to stop the cube

memory_before.text:
POLICY PROMPT FOR MEMORY
  passage_count
      Start at 0 for empty memory, otherwise use the incoming passage_count. Process all newly shown observations chronologically, starting with incoming last_side as the preceding side. Extract cube_x and target_x from the SECOND component of the cube's and target's respective [y, x] positions, never the first component. Compute the sign of cube_x minus target_x. Each nonzero sign opposite to the preceding nonzero side increments the count once; then update the working side. Ignore exact equality until a nonzero side appears. Include observations during A and B, and count multiple crossings within one decision interval separately. Write the resulting count, without adding any predicted future passage from the command being selected. e.g. 2
  last_side
      The cube's most recently observed nonzero side of the target center, represented as -1 when cube x is smaller than target x and 1 when it is larger. Extract x from the SECOND component of each observed [y, x] position for both cube and target, never the first component. Starting with incoming last_side, or 0 for empty memory, process newly shown execution observations chronologically and replace the working side with each nonzero sign of cube_x minus target_x. If exactly equal, retain the preceding nonzero side; use 0 if none has yet been observed. Record the side at the decision's final observation, not the side expected after its selected command. e.g. -1
  motion_history
      With empty memory, start with an empty ordered list; otherwise preserve incoming motion_history. Append all newly shown execution observations chronologically, including the final observation, keeping only one sample for any repeated timestamp. Exclude demonstration observations. Write only observed timestamps and cube x measurements, never predicted positions or command outcomes. Extract every cube_x measurement from the SECOND component of the observed cube [y, x] position, never the first component. Use the combined incoming history and newly shown execution observations to estimate motion for subgoal selection. Do not recount retained history when updating passage_count: that update still uses only newly shown observations and incoming last_side. Each history entry contains a timestamp and a scalar cube x measurement, not a spatial coordinate pair. Serialize the field as list text with single-quoted keys, key order 'time' then 'cube_x', and one space after each colon and comma. Do not include extra outer quotation marks within the value. Use [] for an empty list. This representation does not change the observations retained. e.g. [{'time': 0, 'cube_x': 47}, {'time': 16, 'cube_x': 80}, {'time': 32, 'cube_x': 147}]
MEMORY CARRIED IN
  passage_count=; last_side=; motion_history=
